title: Exact one-way complexity of Index
statement: For every positive integer $n$, the deterministic one-way communication complexity of the Index function on $n$-bit inputs is exactly $n$.
replaced:
The deterministic one-way communication complexity of $\mathrm{IND}_n$ is exactly $n$:
\[
  D^{\to}(\mathrm{IND}_n) = n.
\]
